quote.exact: PET detector modules that utilize light sharing can inherently carry DOI information from the multiple timestamps that are generated per gamma event.

annotations.note: Light-sharing modules give several timestamps per event

quote.exact: The difference between two timestamps that are triggered by scintillation photons traveling in opposite directions signiﬁes the event’s depth-dependent optical photon TOF (oTOF).

annotations.note: oTOF definition: timestamp difference of opposite-travelling photons

quote.exact: However, light leak at the crystal-readout interface substantially degrades the resolution of this oTOF-based depth encoding.

annotations.note: Light leak at readout interface degrades oTOF depth encoding

quote.exact: We demonstrate the feasibility of oTOF-based depth encoding by mitigating light leak in single-ended-readout Prism-PET detector modules using tapered crystals.

annotations.note: Tapering mitigates light leak and recovers oTOF depth encoding

quote.exact: which are tapered down to 1.2 × 1.2 mm2 at the crystal-readout interface

annotations.note: 16x16 array of 1.5x1.5x20 mm3 LYSO tapered to 1.2x1.2 mm2 at readout

quote.exact: The LYSO array couples 4-to-1 to an 8 × 8 array of 3 × 3 mm2 silicon photomultiplier (SiPM) pixels on the tapered end and to a segmented prismatoid light guide array on the opposite end.

annotations.note: 4-to-1 onto 8x8 3x3 mm2 SiPMs, prismatoid guide opposite

quote.exact: It also enabled the utilization of thinner (i.e., 0.1 mm) inter-crystal spacing with barium sulfate as the reﬂector
